title: Longest Window Under a Budget

source.name: Original exercise on two pointers and amortized analysis

statement:
You are given `n` positive integers and a budget `K`. Find the length of the longest contiguous block of the sequence whose sum is at most `K`. Print `0` if even a single element exceeds `K`.

**Input.** First line: `n` and `K`. Second line: the `n` integers.

**Output.** One integer, the maximum length.
constraints: 1 ≤ n ≤ 1000 in this browser version (the idea scales to 2·10^5)
hints: Trying every start and extending to the right is O(n^2) in the worst case. Can the work for one start be reused by the next?
Because all numbers are positive, if the window [l, r] fits the budget then every window inside it fits as well. Moving the right end only ever pushes the left end forward.

Keep a running window sum. For each r add a[r]; while sum > K subtract a[l] and increment l. Each element enters once and leaves at most once, so the total work is O(n) even though there is a loop inside a loop.
editorial:
Maintain a window `[l, r]` and its sum. Extend `r` one step at a time; when the sum exceeds `K`, advance `l` until it fits again. Record `r - l + 1` after each step.

Correctness uses positivity: shrinking a window cannot increase its sum, so once `l` has moved past a position it never needs to come back. The nested loop looks quadratic, but the inner `while` increments `l`, which only goes from `0` to `n` over the whole run; `r` also moves `n` times. Total pointer moves are at most `2n`, which is the amortized argument. Sums reach `n * 10^9`, so use 64-bit integers.

starter.python:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
a = list(map(int, data[2:2 + n]))
# longest contiguous block with sum <= k

solutions.python:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
a = list(map(int, data[2:2 + n]))
l = 0
s = 0
best = 0
for r in range(n):
    s += a[r]
    while s > k:
        s -= a[l]
        l += 1
    best = max(best, r - l + 1)
print(best)
